prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a production 2D cutout rig texture parts sheet from the supplied Darth Vespera game character. Keep her EXACT adult face, African skin, silver-white hair, obsidian and burgundy leather armor, silver bracers, costume seams, lighting and original three-quarter standing pose. This is technical disassembly, not a redesign. Output a large square transparent PNG with a strictly regular 3 column by 3 row grid, nine separate isolated parts, one centered in each cell, generous fully transparent gutters. No grid lines, labels, letters, background, shadows outside objects or extra objects. Equal scale throughout, preserve source orientation. Row 1 left: head with face, front hairline, ears and full neck, omit long ponytail and cape. Row 1 middle: chest and abdomen armor from shoulder sockets to belt, no arms head cape pelvis or hanging red tabard; reconstruct the surface behind the bent hand and cape and extend rounded shoulder/neck/waist overlap pads. Row 1 right: hip/pelvis armor and belt with hip straps from waist to upper thigh joints, no hands, legs, cape or tabard; reconstruct behind the hand. Row 2 left: character's RIGHT upper arm (on viewer left, saber arm), shoulder to elbow in original downward pose, plain black/burgundy sleeve with rounded joint overlap ends. Row 2 middle: same RIGHT forearm with silver bracer, elbow to wrist, original pose, padded rounded overlap ends. Row 2 right: same RIGHT gloved hand grasping the hilt, fingers intact, exclude the entire weapon. Row 3 left: character's LEFT upper arm (on viewer right, bent hip arm), shoulder to elbow, reconstruct hidden area under cape, preserve original slant toward right and downward, rounded shoulder/elbow overlap ends. Row 3 middle: same LEFT forearm silver bracer from elbow to wrist in original slant down-left toward hip, rounded overlap ends. Row 3 right: same LEFT gloved hand resting on hip with all fingers intact and isolated from torso and belt. Each part must be a complete opaque surface without cutout holes for occluding parts. Hidden joint areas should have generous 10 percent matching painted overlap so rotation does not expose gaps. Match exact texture and silhouette of the reference. True alpha transparency everywhere outside parts.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create six clean separate lower-body rig texture pieces of the EXACT supplied Darth Vespera game character. Preserve precise black leather, burgundy hip straps, silver angular engraved greaves and boots, original three-quarter pose and red rim lighting. Large transparent square atlas, strict 2 columns by 3 rows, six objects only, generous clear space between objects and 7 percent transparent margin at all outer edges. Row 1 left: RIGHT thigh on viewer LEFT, hip socket to knee in original diagonal down-left pose. Row 1 right: LEFT thigh on viewer RIGHT, hip socket to knee in original near-vertical pose. Remove cape, pelvis and hanging tabard entirely, reconstruct the surfaces they previously hid. Row 2 left: RIGHT shin with its silver knee guard and greave, viewer LEFT, original lower leg diagonal down-left pose, from just above knee to ankle. Row 2 right: LEFT shin with silver knee guard and greave, viewer RIGHT, original vertical lower leg, from above knee to ankle. Row 3 left: RIGHT complete armored boot, viewer LEFT, original outward pointing toe and heel. Row 3 right: LEFT complete armored boot, viewer RIGHT, original forward-facing toe and heel. All joints must have matching opaque rounded 10 percent overlap pads for mesh rig rotation, boots include ankle overlap. Every piece is isolated with complete painted silhouette. No torso arms hands head sword cape or tabard. No labels, no lines, no separators, no text, no white or colored backdrop, no checkerboard, no unrelated marks. Real alpha transparency outside six objects. Same scale for corresponding paired pieces. This is technical disassembly of the exact reference costume, not new clothing.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Technical texture repair and disassembly for the EXACT supplied Darth Vespera character. Keep the original materials, seams, crimson fabric jacquard pattern, silver white hair and red saber lighting. Large square transparent parts atlas strictly divided into 2 columns and 2 rows, exactly one isolated piece centered within each quadrant, 8 percent transparent gutters, no overlap between quadrants, no labels text boxes or checkerboard. TOP LEFT: her COMPLETE full-length crimson cape, original shoulder on viewer right, draping down into the original bottom folds, reconstruct all fabric that was behind her body and legs, no holes, absolutely no character body, arms legs head armor clasp or other pieces. Preserve its original shoulder silhouette and original right contour. TOP RIGHT: her COMPLETE long flowing silver-white high ponytail ONLY from tie to long tapered strands, same downward-left flow as reference, remove all face ears neck body and clothing, render hidden strands naturally, fine clean alpha edges. BOTTOM LEFT: isolated long narrow burgundy hanging front waist tabard ONLY from original belt attachment to original pointed lower tip, maintain embroidery, no belt buckle pelvis armor or background. BOTTOM RIGHT: her COMPLETE red glowing lightsaber ONLY, fully visible metallic cylindrical hilt plus long red-white blade with subtle transparent glow, original diagonal down-left orientation, no hand or arm, keep full blade inside its cell. All objects genuinely alpha-transparent outside silhouette. These must be reusable separate rig textures for the existing character, not a redesign. Finish occluded surfaces, do not include fragments of other parts.

observations: Generated cells have different scales despite the requested common scale; manual fitting is required.
The accessory atlas contains separator lines; export regions exclude those lines without intersecting the visible objects.
Reconstructed textures are distinct from the original-pixel reference partitions.
